wsib_clearance.evidence: INSURANCE COVERAGE + ATTACHMENTS — WSIB Account #1234567-89 with Clearance Certificate attached and Experience Rating 0.98 (good standing). Manifest qualifications.wsib_clearance_date is null — cert date not transcribed.
wsib_clearance.notes: Account, attachment, and good-standing language all present (fixture 04 §1.3); only the issue date is unverified in the extraction. Re-verify online at clearances.wsib.ca per fixture 04 §1.4 before contract — handled as a standard award condition by the recommendation memo. Tier: statutory.

cgl_insurance.evidence: INSURANCE COVERAGE — 'Commercial General Liability: $5,000,000 per occurrence' meets RFP §5.1.2 minimum_cgl_cad of 5,000,000.
cgl_insurance.notes: Limit meets RFP floor exactly. Tier: statutory.

additional_insured.evidence: Cover letter does not state owner is named as additional insured; manifest qualifications.owner_named_as_additional_insured is null pending COI inspection.
additional_insured.notes: Standard CCDC 2 / commercial baseline (fixture 04 §2). Verify against the actual COI before contract. Tier: statutory.

completed_ops.evidence: Bid states only the $5M per-occurrence limit (cover letter INSURANCE COVERAGE). Completed-operations tail period is not disclosed; manifest qualifications.cgl_completed_operations_years is null.
completed_ops.notes: Required to bracket the warranty period (fixture 04 §2). Owner to request completed-ops endorsement and tail length before contract. Tier: statutory.

performance_bond.evidence: RFP §9.2 requires performance bond 50% of contract value at award. Bid does not address bonding capacity or consent of surety; manifest qualifications.bonding_capacity_cad is null.
performance_bond.notes: OBC Part 3 / Construction Act statutory item — required at contract execution, not at submission. Per fixture 04 §5, missing consent of surety on the successful bidder is a fail at contract signing, not at submission stage. Owner to request bonding letter and consent of surety pre-award. Tier: statutory (timing carries it as needs_clarification at submission).

labour_material_bond.evidence: RFP §9.2 requires L&M bond 50% of contract value. Bid is silent on L&M bonding.
labour_material_bond.notes: Same posture as performance_bond — clarifiable at submission, must be cured before contract. Tier: statutory.

bid_bond.evidence: Bid does not include a bid bond (qualifications.bid_bond_attached=false). RFP submission_requirements (§6.2) lists 13 items; no bid bond is named. mandatory_requirements has no bid_bond_percent field.
bid_bond.notes: Per gate_applicability.py and fixture 04 §5, bid_bond is RFP-specified — when the RFP is silent, missing bid bond is at most a clarification, never a fail. Owner may still request one as a precaution before award. Tier: rfp_specified (not invoked).

working_at_heights.evidence: SAFETY PROGRAM — 'Fall protection training for all workers'; manifest qualifications.working_at_heights_training_confirmed=true.
working_at_heights.notes: Confirmed in narrative form. Owner should request training records (3-yr validity per O. Reg. 297/13) at contract execution. Tier: statutory.

site_visit.evidence: COVER LETTER — 'We attended the mandatory site visit on March 25, 2026.' Satisfies RFP §6.4 / §8.1 mandatory site meeting.

minimum_years_in_business.evidence: COVER LETTER — '12 years' serving GTA; manifest qualifications.years_in_business=12. RFP §5.1.3 requires minimum 10.

similar_project_references.evidence: Three industrial roof replacement references provided: Maple Logistics 62,000 sf (2024), Westpark 71,000 sf (2023), Torque Distribution 55,000 sf (2025). All same building class (industrial commercial), all within 5 years, all >50,000 sf, all within 0.5x-2x of subject 85,000 sf footprint.
similar_project_references.notes: Count meets RFP §5.1.4 minimum of 3. However, the value-proxy comparable test cannot be fully verified — references list sqft and contacts but no project values, so the 0.5x-2x value test from this skill's Gate 8 definition relies on size as a proxy. Owner should request budget values from each reference to confirm comparable scope. Strongest result available is needs_clarification. Tier: rfp_specified.

red_flags.description: No manufacturer-certified installer status claimed and no manufacturer named for the proposed 45-mil TPO. Without manufacturer certification, the bidder cannot deliver a manufacturer-issued NDL or even a typical 20-yr extended warranty (fixture 04 §4). This compounds the warranty-tier deficiency owned by technical-review and limits owner recourse.
red_flags.evidence: KEY SPECIFICATIONS / WARRANTY / ATTACHMENTS — '15-year limited warranty', no manufacturer named, certification_program=null, manufacturer_certified_installer=false.

red_flags.description: Crew size, mobilization-from-award lead time, named foreman, and any Skilled Trades Certificate of Qualification (Roofer 449A) crew composition are all unstated. For an occupied 85,000 sf pharma cold-storage warehouse this is a meaningful gap in the bidder's resourcing story.
red_flags.evidence: Schedule section omits crew_size and mobilization_days; qualifications.certificate_of_qualification_roofers_count=null.

red_flags.description: Owner-named-as-additional-insured and CGL completed-operations tail period are not confirmed in the cover letter. Both are commercial baseline (fixture 04 §2) and must be cured before contract.

Reference values not disclosed — only square footage and owner contacts. The Gate 8 comparable test relies on 0.5x-2x value match; without budget figures the comparability is inferred from size only. Owner should obtain original contract values from each reference to validate.
red_flags.evidence: REFERENCES section — three projects cited with sqft and contact only; manifest references_provided[].value_cad=null.

red_flags.description: Subcontracting posture not declared. Bid does not affirm self-perform or name any subcontractor. Per fixture 04 §5, undisclosed subcontracting of the actual roofing crew is a financial-distress and quality-control signal.
red_flags.evidence: qualifications.subcontracting_declared=false but no affirmative self-perform statement; subcontractors_named=[].

red_flags.description: CRCA membership and any Skilled Trades industry membership are not stated. Not disqualifying, but limits the qualifications_certifications sub-score and signals the bidder is not invested in industry-association reputational scrutiny.
red_flags.evidence: qualifications.crca_member=null; no industry association named in cover letter.

red_flags.description: WSIB clearance certificate date not transcribed; only the account number and good-standing experience rating are visible. Validity window cannot be confirmed from the manifest alone — re-verify online at clearances.wsib.ca before contract (handled as a standard award condition).
